hardBlockers.description: FAIL when harness validation shows that the stage did not leave the required durable artifact or valid repository state.
FAIL when a material ambiguity or contested decision remains unresolved while the stage claims completion.
FAIL when a load-bearing technical or product assumption is accepted without evidence or an explicit owner decision.
FAIL when the hardened design widens or narrows the approved specification without explicit authorization.
FAIL when the hardened design contradicts an accepted requirement without recording and resolving the conflict.

requirements.description: Identify and test the assumptions that determine the design or its feasibility.
Cover material edge cases, failure modes, retries, consistency boundaries, and operational behavior relevant to the feature.
Resolve or explicitly defer every open decision with an owner and scope consequence.
Record accepted risks, rejected alternatives, and the evidence supporting the chosen design.
Trace the hardened design back to the specification without dropping or inventing requirements.

dimensions.description: How effectively the stage attacks weak assumptions and finds consequential omissions.
dimensions.good: B requires the important happy-path, edge-case, and failure assumptions to be challenged.
dimensions.excellent: A requires focused adversarial analysis that finds non-obvious risks without manufacturing irrelevant complexity.

dimensions.description: How well factual claims and decisions are grounded in repository or product evidence.
dimensions.good: B requires every load-bearing claim to have relevant evidence or an explicit decision.
dimensions.excellent: A requires precise evidence that directly distinguishes the chosen design from viable alternatives.

dimensions.description: How consistently the resolved decisions form one implementable design.
dimensions.good: B requires no material contradictions or unexplained gaps between decisions.
dimensions.excellent: A requires a minimal, internally consistent design with clearly bounded accepted risks.
